text:
infra-bot: Warning: elevated connection resets seen on egress proxies in eu-west-2; kernel tcp_tw_recycle/tcp_tw_reuse heuristics causing port reuse errors. Observed spillover into soft-slices at 1719529800.

Maya: Noticed increased `conn_reset_rate` and `nat_port_exhaustion` tags. A few dedicated pools (ded-pool-07) are sending large websocket embed bursts. Could be a single tenant or a client lib bug.

Li: Ran `top-talkers` -> tenant C-77 shows 94% of outgoing ephemeral ports used on proxy-01 in eu-west-2a. C-77 has long-lived multi-socket handshake pattern every 200ms.

Jonah: If proxy host runs out of ephemeral ports we start dropping sockets and router reassigns shards to soft slices; soft slices then see CPU + kvcache miss thrash. We've seen this pattern but this burst is broader across AZs.

Priya: Immediate ask: can we temporarily divert C-77 egress via the high-nat pool (nat-headroom-euw2) and enable conn backpressure on the proxy side? Need to avoid cascading soft-slice thrash.

Maya: I can add a targeted route override for C-77 to nat-headroom-euw2 for 10m. Risk: nat-headroom has lower density and higher cost, but stabilizes client traffic.

Li: Before flip, recommend bumping ip_local_port_range on the C-77-facing proxies and enable `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` bump if conntrack dips. Also consider `tcp_tw_reuse=1` but that's risky with NAT rewriting.

Jonah: Agreed. Ops runbook: 1) apply route override for tenant C-77 to nat-headroom-euw2 (10m) 2) monitor `nat_port_free`, `conntrack_count`, `soft_slice_cpu`, `egress_reroute_count` 3) if soft_slice_cpu > 80% abort.

ops-bot: Runbook action prepared: `routectl override --tenant=C-77 --to=nat-headroom-euw2 --duration=10m --dry-run`. Approval required by oncall.

Priya: Oncall here, approve dry-run then live if metrics look good. Maya please run dry-run and paste plan output.

Maya: Dry-run output: `plan: shift ~88% of C-77 egress; estimated nat-headroom_conn +18%; soft_slice_load +9%`.

Li: That soft_slice delta looks fine. Cost: 10m -> ~0.2 GPU-hours equivalent on headroom nodes (~$1.20). Unlikely to matter vs customer SLA.

Priya: Execute live. Also set a temporary tenant throttle: `max_conn_rate=1000/s` for C-77 while we observe.

Maya: Executing: `routectl override --tenant=C-77 --to=nat-headroom-euw2 --duration=10m` -> `override id=ovr-20260427-001 applied`.

Jonah: Seeing immediate recovery on proxy-01: `nat_port_free` increases, `conn_reset_rate` drops from 14% to 0.9% in 30s. Soft slice cpu up ~5% but stable.

Li: Note: this fixes symptoms. Root cause likely client-side aggressive socket reuse pattern; recommend contacting C-77 PM and ask them to roll out SDK patch to reuse keepalive streams or use multiplexing.

Priya: Agreed. Action items: Maya to keep override live for 10m and then roll back; Li to open INFRA-2399 linking telemetry and suggested kernel tunables (ip_local_port_range, conntrack_max) and a longer-term router policy for preemptive diversion when any tenant uses >60% pool ephemeral ports for >2m; Jonah to draft customer-facing ops note.

Maya: +5m update: override stable; `nat_port_free` healthy; `egress_reroute_count` down. No regressions.

ops-bot: Auto-rollback scheduled at 1719530400 unless `soft_slice_cpu > 85%` or `nat_port_free < 500` for 2m.

Li: One more consideration: cross-region spill. If nat-headroom-euw2 reaches headroom threshold we have to avoid failing over to us-east due to higher egress costs and data residency. Router should prefer same-region headroom or fall back to configured soft-slices with cost-aware scoring.

Jonah: For longer term: propose adding a metric `tenant_ephemeral_share` and rule `if >0.6 for 2m then auto-divert to local-headroom` with a dampening window so we don't thrash between pools. Also measure cost delta and customer impact in evals.

Priya: LGTM. Also add a small runbook section about kernel changes: only after an incident window, we can safely bump ip_local_port_range and conntrack but only with staged deploy across proxies.

Maya: Rollback executed at 1719530400. Override ovr-20260427-001 removed. Post-checks: no regressions, `conn_reset_rate` remains low.

Li: I'll open INFRA-2399: "tenant ephemeral port exhaustion -> auto-diversion policy + kernel hardening" with proposed metrics and a small experiment to gate auto-diversion.

Priya: Great. I'll coordinate a short sync with C-77 PM and send remediation suggestions. Thread closing unless anyone needs follow-up.

infra-bot: Thread archived by automation. Issue INFRA-2399 created and linked to ovr-20260427-001.
